description: This file defines internal registry mechanisms for command line flags in the Abseil C++ library, including functions for iterating over flags, registering, retiring, and managing flag lifecycle, as well as the RetiredFlag class template.

classes.name: RetiredFlag
classes.description: Template class for retiring a flag of type T, which internally calls the Retire function with the flag name and type information.

methods.name: Retire
methods.description: Method to retire a flag with a specific name, using the type T of the flag.
